entries.name: Butterfly
entries.style: low-poly card wings (CDmir 2015, 240 tris): a monarch, its photo texture flattened to flat colours: orange wings with dark tips and a dark body; real size: the rest pose lies with wings spread flat, so a 1 cm rest height gives a 7.9 cm wingspan (a monarch is about 9-10 cm, a garden butterfly 6-10 cm)

source.author: Čestmír Dammer (CDmir, TinyWorlds)
source.note: The plan's own source (gaps list: butterfly, OGA butterfly-animated). license.txt in the zip: Čestmír Dammer, CC0; it adds that the diffuse texture was derived from photo documentation by Rick Hoppmann. Only flat per-face colours sampled from that texture survive in the GLB. The texture flattens to 7 clusters: the orange, yellow and ochre wing faces plus the black #202021 wing-base faces -> wing; #212121 (body, legs and hindwing edges), the brown forewing tips #7b6219 and the untextured remainder -> dark, so it reads as a monarch: orange wings with dark tips. Height 0.01 m is the rest pose with wings flat (legs to wing plane), which makes the wingspan 7.9 cm, inside the real 6-10 cm. Clips: Flying -> fly (0.42 s flap loop, ground clamped: the wings sweep below the body on the downstroke, and the clamp lifts the body as a real downstroke does); Sitting2 (perched, wings closed upright) -> sit and the preview pose; Sitting1 (perched, wings folded back flat) kept under its source name. Both sitting clips are single poses.
